---
title: Manual control
---

```{python}
#| include: false
from ha_automations import fades
```

What happens when you use a light while a light app controls it.

## During a fade

| You | The app |
|---|---|
| Turn the light up | Leaves it. Light apps never lower brightness. It raises the light again once its own level passes yours. |
| Turn the light down | Raises it back to its own level at the next sun update |
| Turn the light off | Turns it back on at the next sun update |
| Turn the light on before the fade | Leaves it. Raises it once the fade's level passes yours. |

## After a fade

| You | The app |
|---|---|
| Turn the light off a little past `to_level` | Leaves it off |
| Turn the light on after `off_level`, app has `start` triggers | Leaves it on |
| Turn the light on after `off_level`, app has no `start` triggers | Turns it off at the next sun update, until the sun turns around at midday or midnight |

## Timing

- The light changes each time Home Assistant updates the sun's elevation, every few minutes.
- Each change is a smooth `{python} fades.RAMP_TRANSITION`-second transition.
- The first change after a start trigger takes `{python} fades.ON_TRANSITION` seconds.
- The fade-out at `off_level` takes `off_transition` seconds, `{python} fades.OFF_TRANSITION` by default.

## Restarts

AppDaemon restarts on each deploy, and when Home Assistant restarts.

| App | After a restart during a fade |
|---|---|
| No `start` triggers, like Sunset Fade | Carries on at the next sun update |
| With `start` triggers, like Sunrise Fade | Stops until the next trigger. Fire the test event to resume. |

## Turn an app off

Add `disable: true` to its entry in `apps.yaml`, then push:

```yaml
bedroom_sunrise:
  module: sunrise_fade
  class: SunriseFade
  light: light.bedroom_lamp
  disable: true
```

Remove the line, or delete the entry, when you are done.

To pause every app, stop the AppDaemon add-on. Disabling the deploy workflow does not pause the apps.
